user.title: Add Eltern-Portal
user.description:
The school code is the part before .eltern-portal.org (e.g. bspgym or musterrs). You can also paste the link from a notification e-mail.

Already added: {added}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Signing in to an Eltern-Portal failed. Please enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Portal not reachable or does not exist.
error.already_added: This school has already been added.

abort.already_configured: Schulmanager is already set up. Add more schools via “Configure”.

data.ai_task_entity: AI service for analysis (AI Task entity)
data.notify_services: Push notifications to (notify services, e.g. mobile_app_…)
data.digest_enabled: Send daily summary in the morning
data.analyze_days: On first import, analyse the last
data.lookback_days: Read portal messages from the last
data.own_class_only: Only appointments of the child's class

data_description.ai_task_entity: Extracts tasks, deadlines, amounts and dates from letters and PDFs. Without AI a simple rule-based detection is used.
data_description.reminder_days: Example 3,1,0 = three days before, the day before and on the day. Overdue tasks are reminded daily.
data_description.auto_download: Note: Eltern-Portal treats downloading a parent letter as acknowledging receipt.
data_description.dashboard: Tabs: “Overview” with calendar and Schulmanager plus one tab per child – best on phones. Single page: everything on one page. Do not manage: the dashboard is left as you built it.
data_description.appointment_kinds: Which entries of the Eltern-Portal "Termine" page appear in the calendar, appointments list and timetable. Default: only exams and tests.
data_description.own_class_only: Hides appointments that explicitly name only other classes or grades (e.g. "Schullandheim 5b+5c", "Jgst. 10"). Appointments without a class stay visible.
data_description.summary_languages: Up to 4 languages; each becomes its own tab in the summary. The first chosen language is used for push notifications. Applies to newly analysed messages; older ones can be updated with "Neu auswerten" (re-analyse).

remove_portal.title: Remove school
remove_portal.description: Tasks and messages of this school are removed from Schulmanager. Stored files stay in the media folder.

error.cannot_connect: Portal not reachable or does not exist.
error.already_added: This school has already been added.

abort.last_portal: The last school cannot be removed – delete the integration instead.

mark_read.name: Mark as read
mark_read.description: Mark one message, all messages of a child, or everything as read.

item_id.name: Message ID
item_id.description: ID from the sensor attributes; empty = all.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark a task as done (or open again).

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Create your own task for a child.

reanalyze.name: Re-analyse
reanalyze.description: Let the AI analyse a message again.

get_overview.name: Get overview
get_overview.description: Return open tasks and unread messages as a response (for scripts and voice assistants).

rebuild_dashboard.name: Rebuild dashboard
rebuild_dashboard.description: Rebuild the “Schule” dashboard for the selected layout – overwrites your own changes.

update_item.name: Edit message
update_item.description: Set the status of a message: open, in progress or done. Done messages count as read and move to "Done".

update_task.name: Edit task
update_task.description: Change status (open / in progress / done), comment, deadline or title of a task.

comment.name: Comment
comment.description: Your own note on the task.
